cleared.check: Task 5: for each operand class that neither closed producer has executed in a checked block, can any PoolManager instruction receive operands of that class, and so compute something from a wrong word there?
cleared.result: No. The classes neither producer executed are SDIV of -2^255 by -1, MOD by zero, SMOD by zero or by a negative divisor, MULMOD and ADDMOD by modulus zero, SIGNEXTEND with an index of 31 or more, BYTE with an index of 32 or more, and SAR by 256 or more; HyperEVM also has no SHL by 256 or more. The PoolManager text cannot produce any of them. The only signed divisors are tick spacings (TickBitmap.sol:24, :26, :57, :64 and Pool.sol:577-578), which PoolManager.sol:119-120 holds between 1 and 32767 at initialize and which reach later calls only through the pool id of an initialized key. Every MOD and assembly DIV divisor is nonzero by an earlier check: UnsafeMath.sol:14 is called with liquidity after SqrtPriceMath.sol:134 and :163 reject zero, with sqrtPriceAX96 (at least MIN_SQRT_PRICE) and with numerator1 / sqrtPX96 + amount after SqrtPriceMath.sol:37 returns on amount 0; UnsafeMath.sol:26 runs only after Pool.sol:401 and :468 test liquidity; FullMath.sol:35 and :48 run after FullMath.sol:30 requires denominator > prod1; FullMath.sol:112 runs after mulDiv has already required a nonzero denominator. MULMOD moduli are not(0), a checked denominator or the constant Q96 (SqrtPriceMath.sol:252). SIGNEXTEND indices are the constants 1, 2 and 15, SAR counts are the constants 8, 128 and 255, and the BYTE indices at BitMath.sol:22 and :45 are masked with and(0x1f, ...), so they are always 0 to 31. The run-time shift counts are bitPos values of at most 255 (TickBitmap.sol:71), masked values, BitMath counts below 256, and getTickAtSqrtPrice counts derived from a most significant bit of at most 159. The PoolManager bytecode has no ADDMOD (out/pm-inventory.json). A wrong word in these classes can therefore change no amount, tick or revert of the PoolManager, and nobody loses through it.

cleared.check: Task 2: PoolManager instructions that no validated MegaETH block has executed with an operand of the class their source line can produce, mapped to src/ through the solc source map of the build (cycles/012/theme-bytecode-coverage.work/srcmap.py, whose runtime equals build/PoolManager.json), and whether one swap, liquidity change or donate reaches them.
cleared.result: Wide-product MULMOD sites without a validated run at that pc: the getAmount1Delta copy of mulDiv (pc 22585, FullMath.sol:24, and pc 22639, FullMath.sol:48, reached from SqrtPriceMath.sol:250) and the round-up MULMOD at pc 23094 (SqrtPriceMath.sol:252), which need liquidity times the price difference of 2^256 or more; the exact-input fee copy (pcs 22445 and 22513, SwapMath.sol:65) for an amountRemaining near 2^236; the Position fee copy (pcs 22316 and 22378, Position.sol:94-96) and the amount above uint160 copy (pcs 22721 and 22763, SqrtPriceMath.sol:97), whose results are only computed in transactions that revert at Pool.sol:192 or Pool.sol:455 and :459 (cycle 24); and the mulDivRoundingUp copy at pc 20958 (FullMath.sol:112 via SqrtPriceMath.sol:105). An ordinary account reaches the getAmount1Delta and fee copies with one swap or one liquidity change in a pool of its own token, as cycle 25 showed through eth_call on all 21 networks with the reference words. The same opcode with the same modulus form has validated wide runs at other pcs (pc 22892 68988 runs in 13570 blocks, pc 22921 68988 in 13570, pc 23678 65106 in 12769), and the producer computed the class in other contracts too. Other sites without the class are unreachable for it: SAR at pc 6059 unpacks feesAccrued, which is never negative (PoolManager.sol:171), SIGNEXTEND at pc 16661 and SDIV/SMOD divisors take tick spacings of at least 1, and the SHL and SHR sites take constant counts or counts bounded below 256 (masked bitPos, BitMath and getTickAtSqrtPrice counts). A wrong word at a wide MULMOD site would change amount1 of one swap step or of a liquidity change in that pool by the error; with liquidity times price difference of 2^256 or more, amount1 exceeds 2^160 units, so currency1 must be a token the account mints itself, and the amount that a wrong word changes directly is in that token. The full list is in out/pm-unexecuted-megaeth.json and out/pm-sites.json.

cleared.check: Task 4 (L-1242): do the HyperEVM replicas nanoreth b92ad36 (rpc.hyperlend.finance) and f0cad31 (rpc.purroofgroup.com) re-execute each block, what do they compare with the producer, and what do they do on a mismatch?
cleared.result: They re-execute every block through the reth engine (block import calls engine.new_payload and turns an Invalid status into a BlockImportError, src/node/network/block_import/service.rs:96-106 at b92ad36, :102 and :143 at f0cad31) and then compare gas used, the receipts root of the receipts with nonzero cumulative gas, the logs bloom and the requests hash with the header (src/node/consensus/reth_copy.rs:12-66, called from src/node/consensus/mod.rs:163 at b92ad36 and :161 at f0cad31). They compare no state root. The hl-archive-node reth fork they pin removes that check: at rev c6e0a06 (b92ad36) crates/engine/tree/src/tree/payload_validator.rs:890-892 discards the computed root with the comment that HyperEVM headers carry a zero state root, and at rev 14509628 (f0cad31) lines 626-627 set the root to zero before comparing it with the header. eth_getBlockByNumber on rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm returns stateRoot 0x00..00 for blocks 33,554,432 and 52,385,694. So a replica rejects a block whose status, gas, logs or bloom differ from the producer, and stops importing there, but it cannot see a storage word that differs without changing a log or gas. This is the measurement behind F-120, which stands.

cleared.check: Does the closed-producer operand census apply to the other 19 networks?
cleared.result: No. On these networks the block producer runs a published client that earlier cycles read, built or ran (OPCODES.md, Check 4 and cycles 9 to 32), and the theme concerns only the closed executors of MegaETH and HyperEVM.

leadResults.answer: Every operand class the PoolManager can produce has validated occurrences on MegaETH (40940 validated blocks, no failure), most of them inside the PoolManager. The classes never executed in any contract (SDIV -2^255 by -1, MOD by zero, SMOD negative divisor, SMOD by zero, ADDMOD modulus 2^256-1, ADDMOD modulus 0, MULMOD modulus 0, SIGNEXTEND index >= 31, BYTE index >= 32, SAR negative value, shift >= 256, SAR non-negative value, shift >= 256) cannot arise from any PoolManager line. Per-pc gaps remain at the wide MULMOD sites of the getAmount1Delta and exact-input fee copies of mulDiv, which only replicas have run (cycle 25).

The replicas re-execute every block and compare gas used, receipts root and logs bloom; no state root exists to compare (zero in headers, check removed in the pinned reth fork at both commits). On a mismatch they refuse the block. In 2833 replica-traced transactions every PoolManager-reachable class occurs. F-120 stands: storage that changes no receipt is not independently checked.
